logic.text: The experiment requires an external trial file and never calls the simulation function or generates the design cells.
logic.note: The plan requires the delivered script to run the cell sweep and produce its own trial records.
logic.fix: Add a driver that constructs every cell, runs its trials, and passes those records to the summaries and figures.

logic.text: Each trial uses a supplied seed directly, with no master SeedSequence or child stream for its cell.
logic.note: The plan specifies a separate child stream per ordered cell and successive draws from that stream.
logic.fix: Spawn cell streams from the master SeedSequence and draw successive trials from each cell's generator.
logic.name: seed

logic.text: Per-procedure arrays are grouped by cell without matching trial identifiers before the paired power difference is calculated.
logic.note: Elementwise subtraction and its paired bootstrap interval require the two methods' values to come from the same trial.
logic.fix: Join procedure records by trial identifier and reject missing or duplicate trial matches.
logic.name: paired_power_difference

logic.text: The p-value calculation subtracts a normal CDF from one instead of evaluating the normal survival function.
logic.note: Cancellation can round a small continuous tail probability to zero, changing rejection decisions.
logic.fix: Evaluate the normal survival function directly.
logic.name: realized_fdr

logic.text: The normalized record replaces source run counts with fixed success and failure counts.
logic.note: The reported counts can disagree with the supplied trial record, while the plan requires complete trials for each cell.
logic.fix: Preserve source run counts, validate them, and derive aggregate counts from the validated records.
logic.name: failure_count

logic.text: The summaries report interval endpoints without reporting observed interval widths.
logic.note: The method explicitly requires those widths to accompany its precision assessment.
logic.fix: Calculate each width from its interval endpoints and include it in the result.

logic.text: The power figure draws the theoretical curve without its numerical rounding error.
logic.note: The planned figure explicitly includes that error with the reference.
logic.fix: Compute the reference with a stable tail quantile and show or annotate the numerical rounding error.
